It exposes 4 genuine site-defined children (breadcrumb-confirmed): Outlet Linge de Maison (Home Linens), Outlet Table et Cuisine (Kitchen & Table), Outlet Petit Electromenager (Small Appliances), Outlet Decoration (Decor). Counts taken from each page's own 'search-result-count' span (X resultats). Product grids verified present (86 product-tile markup hits on the parent page, consistent with ~42 real product tiles rendered). DERNIERE CHANCE (LAST CHANCE) EXCLUDED AS EMPTY: /c/maison/derniere-chance and all 4 of its children (linge-de-maison, table-et-cuisine, petit-electromenager, decoration) render the site's 'search-no-result-cross-sell' recommendation slot instead of a product grid -- i.e. the taxonomy node exists but currently holds 0 products (same signature as the previously-documented empty 'cache-pots' node). Per brief, zero-product listings are dropped rather than emitted as qty:0 rows -- this is a genuine currently-empty node, not a fetch failure. No other Soldes/Destockage/Fin de serie branch was found in the category or content sitemaps for Maison; the site's general 'Soldes' promo campaign (mode/seasonal, sitewide banner) was not found as a distinct Maison-scoped permanent-markdown listing separate from Outlet, so it was not double-counted.
